description:
Use this when the user wants posts planned in one go: "plan my week", "post this clip on TikTok and Shorts".
Saves one DRAFT per clip and platform at the user's best times, with each clip's caption and hashtags: the
top-scoring unposted clips, or clip_ids. Scheduling is update_draft schedule=true after the user confirms.
Not for: one post with the user's own caption (draft_post). Free.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips; omit = top-scoring unposted

platforms.description: tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads, bluesky; Shorts, Reels, IG work

name: plan_posts
title: Plan posts
